민수기-26-1.title: 민수기 26장 1절 역사문법적 주해
민수기-26-1.exegesis: 18. they vex you with their wiles-- Instead of open war, they plot insidious ways of accomplishing your ruin by idolatry and corruption. their sister-- their countrywoman.
민수기-26-1.theologicalNote: 18. they vex you with their wiles-- Instead of open war, they plot insidious ways of accomplishing your ruin by idolatry and corruption. their sister-- their countrywoman.

민수기-26-2.title: 민수기 26장 2절 역사문법적 주해
민수기-26-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 26 Nu 26:1-51 . Israel Numbered. 1. after the plague-- That terrible visitation had swept away the remnant of the old generation, to whom God sware in His wrath that they should not enter Canaan ( Psa 95:11 ).
민수기-26-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 26 Nu 26:1-51 . Israel Numbered. 1. after the plague-- That terrible visitation had swept away the remnant of the old generation, to whom God sware in His wrath that they should not enter Canaan ( Psa 95:11 ).

민수기-26-3.title: 민수기 26장 3절 역사문법적 주해
민수기-26-3.exegesis: 2. Take the sum of all the congregation-- The design of this new census, after a lapse of thirty-eight years, was primarily to establish the vast multiplication of the posterity of Abraham in spite of the severe judgments inflicted upon them; secondarily, it was to preserve the distinction of families and to make arrangements, preparatory to an entrance into the promised land, for the distribution of the country according to the relative population of the tribes.

민수기-26-8.title: 민수기 26장 8절 역사문법적 주해
민수기-26-8.exegesis: 7. These are the families of the Reubenites-- the principal households, which were subdivided into numerous smaller families. Reuben had suffered great diminution by Korah's conspiracy and other outbreaks [Nu 16:1].

민수기-26-11.title: 민수기 26장 11절 역사문법적 주해
민수기-26-11.exegesis: 10. the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah-- rather, "the things of Korah." (See on Nu 16:35 ; compare Psa 106:17 ).
민수기-26-11.theologicalNote: 10. the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah-- rather, "the things of Korah." (See on Nu 16:35 ; compare Psa 106:17 ).

민수기-26-12.title: 민수기 26장 12절 역사문법적 주해
민수기-26-12.exegesis: 11. Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not-- Either they were not parties to their father's crime, or they withdrew from it by timely repentance. His descendants became famous in the time of David, and are often mentioned in the Psalms [Psa 42:1; 44:1; 45:1; 46:1; 47:1; 48:1; 49:1; 84:1; 85:1; 87:1; 88:1], also in 1Ch 6:22 , 38 .

민수기-26-13.title: 민수기 26장 13절 역사문법적 주해
민수기-26-13.exegesis: 12. The sons of Simeon-- It is supposed that this tribe had been pre-eminent in the guilt of Baal-peor and had consequently been greatly reduced in numbers. Thus God's justice and holiness, as well as His truth and faithfulness, were strikingly displayed: His justice and holiness in the sweeping judgments that reduced the ranks of some tribes; and His truth and faithfulness in the extraordinary increase of others so that the posterity of Israel continued a numerous people.

Thus God's justice and holiness, as well as His truth and faithfulness, were strikingly displayed: His justice and holiness in the sweeping judgments that reduced the ranks of some tribes; and His truth and faithfulness in the extraordinary increase of others so that the posterity of Israel continued a numerous people.

민수기-26-54.title: 민수기 26장 54절 역사문법적 주해
민수기-26-54.exegesis: 53. the land shall be divided according to the number of names-- The portion of each tribe was to be greater or less, according to its populousness.
민수기-26-54.theologicalNote: 53. the land shall be divided according to the number of names-- The portion of each tribe was to be greater or less, according to its populousness.

민수기-26-55.title: 민수기 26장 55절 역사문법적 주해
민수기-26-55.exegesis: 54. To many thou shalt give the more inheritance-- that is, to the more numerous tribes a larger allotment shall be granted. according to those that were numbered-- the number of persons twenty years old at the time of the census being made, without taking into account either the increase of those who might have attained that age, when the land should be actually distributed, or the diminution from that amount, occasioned during the war of invasion.

민수기-26-56.title: 민수기 26장 56절 역사문법적 주해
민수기-26-56.exegesis: 55. the land shall be divided by lot-- The appeal to the lot did not place the matter beyond the control of God; for it is at His disposal ( Pr 16:33 ), and He has fixed to all the bounds of their habitation. The manner in which the lot was taken has not been recorded. But it is evident that the lot was cast for determining the section of the country in which each tribe should be located--not the quantity of their possessions. In other words, when the lot had decided that a particular tribe was to be settled in the north or the south, the east or the west, the extent of territory was allocated according to the rule ( Nu 26:54 ).

민수기-26-65.title: 민수기 26장 65절 역사문법적 주해
민수기-26-65.exegesis: 64. among these there was not a man ... numbered ... in the wilderness of Sinai-- The statement in this verse must not be considered absolute. For, besides Caleb and Joshua, there were alive at this time Eleazar and Ithamar, and in all probability a considerable number of Levites, who had no participation in the popular defections in the wilderness. The tribe of Levi, having neither sent a spy into Canaan, nor being included in the enumeration at Sinai, must be regarded as not coming within the range of the fatal sentence; and therefore it would exhibit a spectacle not to be witnessed in the other tribes of many in their ranks above sixty years of age.
